title: Deflake TestWaitForState_ContextCancelled
description: internal/session.TestWaitForState_ContextCancelled intermittently reaches Idle before its 50ms cancellation despite 2ms output heartbeats. Observed one failure in make test and 3 failures across go test ./internal/session -run TestWaitForState_ContextCancelled -count=20 on 2026-08-06. Make the test deterministically prove context cancellation without scheduler/timer races; do not weaken Session.WaitForState coverage.
